engine.summary: Numerical primitives: descriptive statistics and sample quantiles, normal, t, F and chi-squared distribution functions, parametric distributions with seeded sampling, Box-Cox, real FFT of any length, half-open interval sets and unit conversion.

surfaces.name: u-numflow
surfaces.error_shape: Err(...) of the module's error type where a function can refuse; statistics of too few values return None, and the bare distribution functions return NaN outside their domain.

surfaces.name: @iyulab/u-numflow
surfaces.note: Numbers arrays may be passed as number[] or Float64Array; arguments and results are typed in the .d.ts. Bundler and Node targets; no bundler-less browser build.
surfaces.error_shape: A thrown Error whose code property is the code, with the fields (parameter, index, min, max, exclusive_min, got, expected, ...) as its other properties.

surfaces.name: UNumflow
surfaces.note: C ABI wrapper over the same wire layer; versioned on its own axis, not with the crate.
surfaces.error_shape: A NumflowException whose ErrorCode is the code, Parameter and Index the fields of those names, and Details the rest.

errors.shape: A refusal carries a stable snake_case 'code' and the fields listed for that code; how it arrives depends on the surface (error_shape).

source.catalog: code_catalog in src/wire.rs, built from the Code table the refusals are made from; published as codes() in WebAssembly, unumflow_codes() over the C ABI and Codes on .NET. What each code means is tabled in README.md, which a test holds equal to the catalog.

operations.summary: The arithmetic mean of a non-empty sample (Kahan compensated summation).

checks.claim: The mean of a 41-value and a 40-value normal draw equals NumPy's (sample variance with ddof = 1, median of an even length is the mean of the middle pair), and the variance of 60 values on an offset of 1e9 with unit spread equals the exact-arithmetic variance.
checks.reference: NumPy 2.4.6 mean, var(ddof=1), std(ddof=1), median; exact rational arithmetic (fractions) for the offset case
checks.method: compares the odd and even samples, and the offset sample

limits: Finite data of ordinary magnitude; overflow of the squares near 1e154 is not covered.

operations.summary: n variates of a parametric distribution, reproducible from the seed: the same (distribution, n, seed) always gives the same values. The distribution is {kind, ...parameters}: uniform, triangular, pert, normal, lognormal, weibull, exponential, gamma, beta or chi_squared.

determinism.note: The seed is a required argument; there is no unseeded call.

checks.claim: The fraction of a 20,000-value seeded sample below each of the 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 0.9 quantiles of the same distribution (uniform, triangular, normal, log-normal, Weibull, exponential, gamma, beta, chi-squared, PERT) is that probability to four standard errors.
checks.reference: SciPy 1.17.1 ppf of the matching distribution (PERT as the scaled beta with 1 + 4(mode-min)/(max-min) and 1 + 4(max-mode)/(max-min))
checks.method: draws 20,000 values with seed 11 for one parameter set of each distribution
checks.tolerance: 4 standard errors of the binomial fraction

limits: One parameter set per distribution; the draws are specific to this crate's generator and are compared with SciPy's distribution, not SciPy's stream. The crate's own tests also compare each sample with the distribution's CDF (Kolmogorov-Smirnov).

performance.complexity: O(n) draws; each O(1) or a short rejection loop (gamma, beta).

operations.summary: A reading in one unit expressed in another (20 Cel is 293.15 K): UCUM-style expressions over the SI units and the caller's own definitions; units of different dimensions are refused.

checks.claim: Prefixed and compound SI expressions convert by the factors their definitions give (km, cm, mmol, kPa, MHz, uV, mT, dam, g/cm3, N.m, W.s, V = W/A, ...), Celsius converts with the 273.15 offset and a difference without it, other dimensions and an offset unit inside a product are refused.
checks.reference: the SI Brochure (BIPM, 9th ed.) definitions of the prefixes and coherent derived units; UCUM (Schadow & McDonald) expression syntax
checks.method: converts 22 expressions and checks the refusals

limits: SI units only (other units are defined by the caller); UCUM's special units (e.g. logarithmic) and the full annotation syntax are not covered.

performance.complexity: Linear in the length of the two expressions and the definitions.
